reviewed_directions.title: Keep online shops working after software updates
reviewed_directions.problem: A web agency maintaining several shops has to check that customers can still place orders after updates. A recurring service could test the shops and repair broken custom code.
reviewed_directions.finding: Maintenance firms already sell testing and repairs. The recent checkout bugs we checked were fixed. We have not identified an agency need these services handle poorly.

reviewed_directions.title: Keep a bakery’s daily café orders organised
reviewed_directions.problem: A wholesale bakery needs to combine regular orders and late changes, pack the right quantities, record shortages and send correct totals for billing.
reviewed_directions.finding: Existing bakery systems already cover much of this workflow. We have no recent independent evidence of a specific recurring problem they leave unsolved.

reviewed_directions.title: Run a repair shop’s jobs and customer updates
reviewed_directions.problem: Repair shops need to track devices, quotes, progress and messages to customers.
reviewed_directions.finding: The reviewed discussion already pointed to tools meeting the requested need. A replacement would add migration work without an established benefit.
